sloka: एवम् उक्तो दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरकत लोचनः ।अकंपनम् उवाच इदम् निर्दहन् इव तेजसा ॥३-३१-३॥
transliteration: evam ukto daśagrīvaḥ kruddhaḥ saṁrakata locanaḥ ।akaṁpanam uvāca idam nirdahan iva tejasā ॥3-31-3॥

translations.english: When Akampana thus reported to the tenheaded Ravana, his eyes reddened with anger. He spoke to Akampana as if he was burning him with his eyes :
translations.hindi: बढ़ बढ़ कर बातें मारने बाले, तुझ ढीठ की, शात्रुनाशिनी यह्‌ गदा, मेरे बाणों से चूर हो, प्रथिवी पर पड़ी है
